subject: Draft MAP & governance alignment for FinWave - next steps and owners
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finwave.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP & governance alignment for FinWave - next steps and owners

Alicia / Tom — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached + link) so we have clear owners, milestones, and a target close date. Please confirm the governance roles below and any corrections to timeline/dependencies.

Attachments: FinWave_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_draft_v1.pdf
Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/finwave/MAP/FinWave_MAP_v0.2

High-level recap from call:
- Primary business outcome: move from PoC to production inference for analytics pipelines (latency < 120ms p50).
- Key blockers: security questionnaire, procurement/legal review, and an infra demo for your eng team.

Proposed MAP milestones (owner suggestions in parentheses):
1) Kickoff & architecture deep-dive — by 2026-11-17 (Redwood eng: Rahul Mehta (please confirm), FinWave eng: Rahul Mehta?)
2) PoC demo (restricted dataset) — target 2026-11-30 (owner: Redwood eng)
3) Security questionnaire & workshop — target 2026-12-06 (owner: FinWave security / Redwood security)
4) Commercial review & procurement approval — target 2026-12-15 (owner: FinWave procurement)
5) Contract signature & PO issuance — target 2026-12-20 (owner: FinWave legal / procurement)

Governance / RACI we asked to confirm today (please mark primary owner):
- Economic buyer: ?
- Security owner: ?
- Legal owner: ?
- Engineering lead: ?

Dependencies we flagged:
- SOC2 evidence and attestation (we attached a stub);
- Short infra/demo environment and sample dataset;
- Purchase order / procurement cadence (timeline from your legal/procurement).

Ask: Can you confirm the four governance owners above and whether the target close date Dec 20 is realistic? If agreed, I will update the MAP and send a final version for sign-off. Also please confirm availability for a 60-min security workshop week of 11/16 or 11/23.

Thanks — Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.ai

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finwave.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwave.com>, Kiran Shah <kiran.shah@finwave.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@finwave.com>, Rahul Mehta <rahul.mehta@finwave.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & governance alignment for FinWave - next steps and owners

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear plan and the MAP draft. Confirming governance roles from our side: 
- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (vp of data & analytics) — tom.reynolds@finwave.com
- Security owner: Kiran Shah (security lead) — kiran.shah@finwave.com
- Legal owner: Sarah Patel (counsel) — sarah.patel@finwave.com
- Engineering lead: Rahul Mehta (staff eng) — rahul.mehta@finwave.com

Procurement notes: our legal/procurement team aims to complete commercial review by 2026-12-01; PO issuance typically ~2 weeks after contract execution (so PO by ~2026-12-20 is possible but optimistic). We can target contract execution by 2026-12-15 if technical and security sign-off are complete.

Security workshop: Kiran can do a 60-min session on Thu 19 Nov (11/19) 10:00-11:00 PT. He also asked for a short pre-read: SOC2 control mapping + list of endpoints that Redwood will touch. I see you attached a SOC2 attestation stub — that helps.

I'll review the MAP and propose a couple of edits; otherwise the milestones look reasonable. Can you confirm Redwood leads for the PoC demo and the infra environment? Also — who should I expect to run the security workshop from Redwood?

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director, Strategic Partnerships — FinWave Analytics

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finwave.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & governance alignment for FinWave - next steps and owners

Alicia / team — thanks for the quick confirmation and for locking the governance roster. A couple of updates from our side:
- Redwood will own the PoC demo and will provide an infra environment (private tenant) and sample dataset. I'll have our eng lead (Neha) run the demo with Rahul on 11/30 — Neha, can you take point?
- For the security workshop on 11/19, Neha and I will join; we'll bring our security engineer (internal) and a short controls deck.

Updated suggested milestone dates (we think are conservative but achievable):
1) Kickoff & arch deep-dive — 2026-11-17 (owner: FinWave eng + Redwood eng)
2) PoC demo (private tenant) — 2026-11-30 (owner: Redwood eng — Neha Kapoor)
3) Security workshop & questionnaire completion — 2026-12-06 (owner: Kiran Shah + Neha Kapoor)
4) Commercial/legal review complete — 2026-12-15 (owner: FinWave legal)
5) Contract execution & PO target — 2026-12-20 (owner: FinWave procurement/legal)

Neha — please confirm you'll lead the PoC demo and security session. Also Alicia / Tom — if Dec 20 PO target is tight, tell us the critical path we should accelerate (e.g., prioritizing the security workshop + redwood SOC2 evidence).

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finwave.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & governance alignment for FinWave - next steps and owners

Appreciate the confirmations and the accelerated replies. Per Ben / Alicia above, I've updated the MAP (FinWave_MAP_v0.2.xlsx) with:
- Confirmed governance owners (Economic buyer: Tom R.; Security owner: Kiran S.; Legal owner: Sarah P.; Eng lead: Rahul M.).
- Revised milestone dates and owners to reflect internal commitments (see attached).
- Dependencies called out clearly: SOC2 evidence (attached stub), security Q-as, and infra availability for demo.

Action items / asks:
- Alicia / Tom: please acknowledge the governance roster above and confirm that target close (contract signed + PO) of 2026-12-20 is acceptable. If you need a different target date, please propose one by EOD Tue 2026-11-17 so we can adjust resource planning.
- Kiran: please confirm 11/19 10:00-11:00 PT for the security workshop and any pre-read requests.
- Neha: please confirm you'll run the 11/30 PoC demo with Rahul.

Next steps once we have confirmations: I'll produce a final MAP (v0.3) and a one-page mutual action plan summary for Tom to route to procurement/legal.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this locked in.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
Attachments: FinWave_MAP_v0.2.xlsx, SOW_draft_v1.pdf, SOC2_attestation_stub.pdf
